dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Phew. Lantern Rite sure is a tiring time. Best I go get some rest...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: But a strange anxiety seems to take me whenever I stop...

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: I had to prepare so many extra ritual supplies this year on top of last years' items... My workflow is getting real stretched here.

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: The longer my list of tasks, the more stressed I get, so I've got to hurry and shorten it as soon as possible...
